scope: Sequential direct existing-engine lifecycle APIs, shared single-writer JSON store, two synthetic tenants, idempotent local simulated provider; no hosted billing, MCP transport or Grok reasoning included

measurement.cpu: Process user+system CPU deltas per sequential known-tenant request, milliseconds
measurement.memory: Sampled whole-process RSS; maximum observed, not a continuous peak or per-tenant memory bill
measurement.storage: Actual end-of-run physical file sizes; per-tenant compact JSON byte contributions are logical sizes, not allocated physical storage
measurement.io: Returned writeSync bytes, fsync and rename calls restricted to temporary fixture files; retries included
measurement.latency: saveTurn/receive/claim/propose/tick/read wall time, including fsync and controlled immediate retries; not real SMS or live-agent latency
measurement.retry: One lost acknowledgment for every tenth A request after a persisted local delivery; idempotent retries reuse the same key

limitations: No enforced per-tenant budget/rate limiter exists in this demo
No property/access/OAuth/provider-credential production tenancy is tested
Sequential actor attribution is not concurrent production metering
Global JSON snapshots grow with all retained tenant histories; extrapolating constant per-message CPU to production is unsupported
Sampled RSS includes Node/tsx/dependency overhead; no per-tenant baseline/idle allocation measured

idle.note: Completed retained history only; no external agent, queued work or sends

costAnalysis: Deferred by user; resource data is performance evidence, not a hosting cost estimate
reportMetadataAmendment: Cost metadata removed after the user deferred costs; measured rows and original run timestamp unchanged. runnerSha256 identifies the code at measurement time.
